maria: Heads-up — APAC prefix cache hit-rate dropped ~22% after yesterday's kernel micro-optimizations + routing weight tweak. Profiling attached, this is causing token latency spikes for a subset of tail requests. Anyone else seeing it?

ken: Seen a smaller dip in eu-west earlier today. suspects: cache key format change or eviction churn.

alex: Pasting perf snapshot from perf-bot run (2026-03-15 11:58):

```
perf-summary 2026-03-15 11:58
Region   Hit%   AvgTokLat(ms)  95p(ms)  Evictions/min
us-east  78.2   8.5            32       12
eu-west  74.1   9.2            38       18
apac     56.7   14.9           92       71
```

sam: Two obvious suspects: 1) kernel selection change introduced slightly higher memory working set -> more KV evictions, 2) routing policy now favors cross-region replicas so APAC traffic hitting cold caches.

irene: Confirm — we rolled routing tweak at 2026-03-15T11:55:10 (canary->gradual) to shift 15% of apac traffic to eu cache replicas to smooth load. That'll increase miss amplification.

ken: Quick mitigations to try (low-risk):
- revert routing weight for APAC to previous baseline (route back to local primary)
- enable aggressive prefetch/warmup for APAC: prefetch window 30m for top N prefixes
- tighten cache key to include model_rev + 8-char prompt-hash (avoid accidental key diversification from extra metadata)

maria: Can someone run a canary to adjust routing back to 0.1 for APAC and enable prefetch TTL=30m for the next 2h? We want to see delta within 30 mins.

deploy-bot: @maria canary jobs queued: `route-canary apac weight=0.1  start=1799998920` and `prefetch-toggle apac ttl=30m start=1799998950` — will report when metrics show 10m windows.

alex: Nice signal. Still want a deeper KV eviction trace to confirm root cause. Run: `./tools/kv-prof --region apac --duration 1h --sample-rate 0.1` and collect kernel memory churn profile.

sam: Opening GH issue with actions: rollback routing tweak OR add fallback that pins hot prefixes for 1h, plus KV telemetry improvements (hot-prefix LRU counters). Issue: redwood/eng-runtime#4923 — assigning to @sam and @alex.

maria: Thanks. If perf stays improved after 2h, we'll keep prefetch for 4 more hours and run a controlled kernel A/B to isolate memory behavior. Ping here with any anomalies. :thumbsup:
